brief_title: An Open-label Extension to Assess the Continued Efficacy of Omacor Plus Simvastatin
official_title: An Open-label Extension of a Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Crossover Study to Evaluate Simvastatin 20 mg Plus Omacor 4g Compared to Simvastatin 20 mg Plus Placebo in Subjects With Mixed Dyslipidemia

primary_outcomes.measure: Median % Change in Non-HDL-C From Baseline to Week 6

brief_summary: The primary objective of this trial is to assess the continued efficacy of Omacor co-administered with simvastatin for lowering non-high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (non-HCL-C) levels.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Must have met all relevant inclusion/exclusion criteria prior to and throughout the previous double-blind study (PRV-06009)
* Must have completed the previous double-blind study to week 12.
* Provide written informed consent and authorization for protected health information

Exclusion Criteria:

* Study drug compliance less than 50% in PRV-06009
* Any ongoing serious adverse event from PRV-06009
